decision.reason: [ev-b62da9c1ceb5] gives the condition only in prose: external workloads are in use and the cluster has no Cluster name and ID. It names no configuration key for external workloads or for the cluster name/ID, so the exposure condition cannot be written without guessing. The surrounding section [ev-12660f87be40] adds that KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default in Clustermesh, and gives the opt-out key clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false, which can serve as an exclusion. Neither excerpt says what happens if the operator does nothing. The missing pieces are the external-workloads setting, the cluster name/ID settings, and the failure mode, likely in the external-workloads or clustermesh docs, which are not shown.
